turn: The attachment storage step on the object store is finished. The last commit adds a test in src/attach/expire.test.ts. It checks that a temporary upload chunk whose age is just over TEMP_TTL_MS (one day) is reported as expired by expired(). I haven't run the test suite in this session, so the new test hasn't been confirmed passing. While in the same commit I noticed that the upload helper built object keys with a doubled slash when the prefix already ended in one. I changed it to trim the trailing slash before joining, so keys are now consistent. That change is unrelated to this step and is the only thing I touched beyond the test. Next I will start "Audit log of sync writes".

sidefix.title: Avoid doubled slash in object keys
sidefix.what: The upload helper now trims a trailing slash from the key prefix before joining, so keys no longer contain a double slash.
